parts.title: Part 1 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Read each question and answer Yes or No. Press ? if you did not understand. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer; ? scores 0.

parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: the four seasons of the year are
precede the teacher into the classroom,
the taste of coffee without sugar.

parts.text: The names of the four seasons of the year are spring, summer, autumn and winter. Sometimes the students precede the teacher into the classroom, but not always. My mother doesn't like the taste of coffee without sugar. My brother is the one who gets up the earliest in my family.
